name: B10-0423/2026 – § 24
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the upcoming EU anti-corruption strategy
part_text: Expects the next multiannual financial framework to strengthen rule of law conditionality as a means to protect the EU budget, thus reinforcing the role of the Rule of Law Conditionality Regulation and consequently of the annual rule of law cycle; calls on the Commission to ensure that future national and regional programmes include dedicated anti-corruption milestones and targets, where relevant, to strengthen prevention, detection and accountability in the use of EU funds; reiterates that decisions regarding funding in the context of rule of law conditionality should be based on transparent, objective and enforceable criteria, including at regional and local level;
